identity.highLevel: Official designated lighthouse at the civic point #198, gov DFO aid 1018/H1046; existing AEB ring q03020/133 + separate provincial row 27637 both contain that civic locator. q03020/130 and provincial 27636/whichever explicitly separate northern #190 group are protected, not substitutes. One official aid locator ~17m from tower is not nail position. Historical site moved back from coast 1979; no reconstruction of former 19th-century lighthouse or keeper dwelling, which was removed about 1960.
identity.sourceDisagreement: Federal/provincial outline areas ~35.28 and 43.39m², centroid 2.35m apart; neither is proof of the actual physical base. Society describes an 11ft 3in BASE SIDE, not total span. A regular octagon at 3.429m side has 8.28m across flats and 56.77m²; cannot call reduced AEB/other service a verified physical perimeter.

nativeXY.roofCore: Unique genuine class 6 original pulses only. Radius <=5.5m of the two-authority search midpoint; angular quadrants relative native East/North; report independent returns in radius <=2.0 and annulus (2.0,5.5], plus four exterior 5.5–8m quadrants to reveal shape truncation. Do not select high cells. No class1/vegetation/bright returns as retrospective tower. All original returns including below/above diagnostic 1,6,2,9 counted in XY but only class6 admitted for roof. If class6 shape gate fails, stop without looking at Z. Independent older AEB/official line only for identifying source candidate, not template for native or traced asset.
nativeXY.grade: Class 2 true ground in radial 8–24m annulus, four fixed cardinal XY quadrants. Retain clear controls only outside 2m buffers around all historic game and current provincial building footprints/curbs/roads/parking or water. Report all class2 and candidate grounds separately rather than cherry-pick low subjects. No inferred current material or approach under same return.
nativeXY.weaks: Drop las synthetic, withheld, key_point, overlap, nonfinite GPS time and sources not identifiable. De-duplicate each acquired scan pulse by point_source_id/scan_channel/GPS bit identity for eligibility and split; keep all returns of one pulse together. No new numeric Z only for counts or failed eligibility.

splitAndGates.split: Seal coordinate labels pre-Z. Phase 0: checksum all X/Y, flags, point ID, pulse. Apply 1.5m source-UTM floor-index cell hash seeded with PEI-SEACOW-233-V1 to pick spatial held cells where u16(fingerprint) mod 5=0; all their pulses held. All non-spatial-held group pulse hashes with same seed mod 5=0 also held; remaining pulses train. Bands, source line and false-alternative row cannot cross pulse identities.
splitAndGates.roofPrerequisite: At least two identifiable distinct original point-source flightlines each with >=12 qualifying train and >=5 held unique class6 tower pulses, each represented in >=3 of 4 source horizontal quadrants across both sets; at least one train and one held per line in core radius2.0m and outer annulus. At least 3 distinct occupied 1.5m spatial hold cells. Require corroborated coverage on actual EPSG2961 bounds before counts. If no pass, do not release/open original numerical roof labels.
splitAndGates.gradePrerequisite: At least two distinct source flightlines each containing >=20 train and >=10 held genuine class2 in verified dry ring, each at >=3 of4 quadrants. No numeric grade alone if physically useless: sample only after an exact hypothetical model needs local support, or if engineer requests separately.
splitAndGates.afterQualifying: Supply only training source heights in split. Model artist must freeze all ground/shape offsets and actual 3D world buffers after fitting; independently raycast real submitted triangles at all held XY/matching class. Predeclared: two-line local ground train/held median error<=0.15m,p90<=0.40m; cross-line recovered base spread <=0.25m; independent apex claim only where both flightlines supply consistent high structural support; merged held height errors for populated roof/rim <=0.35/0.9m median/p90, with no separate flightline/arc pooled away. If incomplete, use documented 18.3m as approximate overall citation only or hold. Do not shift to fit new labels or choose better neighbors.
splitAndGates.higherTier: If original cannot measure shape, geographically anchored visually/archivally authored alternative is a separate declared product, not surveyed. Keep old scene/ground/collider/near #130, no cliff changes; robust candidate structural placement first: visible original separately identified actual ring replaced, no two towers, home proved independently by source. Independent as-built unresolved true horizontal orientation stays approximate and only publicly claim supported subfeatures.

predeclaredFeatures: Bright tapering octangular tower distinct from a cylinder or square; independently real multilayer cornice/railed gallery with separate narrow circumferential lantern and red roof

Correct visually distinct six-over-six window openings, pedimented heads and door (not painted rectangular plate); no all-eight-face repeat without evidence. Faced upper lantern (12 per original Society text if actually visible); open real red octagonal railing and slender posts from contemporary evidence if corroborated.

White shingle-profile appearance vs actual ECCC remediation selection of vinyl in 2021/2022; no unsupported raw wood or decay. Red accents/windows and overall white/red. Distinguish physically low-contrast siding and windows from cladding texture drawn at giant scale. Numeric lamp focal 26.8m above-water not architectural tip; central light/flash not navigation simulation, not a generic daytime red beam.
New 2024 doorway/ramp/visitor features must have explicit post-remediation observation and independent support, or remain absent/unverified. No keeper house, sheds, fences or foliage invented.
appearance.releaseGates: Before candidate geometry lock two actual opposed near angles (ground visitor from NW and independent sea-facing approach), one low roof/lantern silhouette control using viewpoint not from fit image; medium/far flight recognizable and exact non-site camera plus shape fallback. Actual original+candidate all neighbor AEB colors/geometries, coast, paths, roads grade/collider unchanged, above grade/body-to-foot contact across 8 source faces, no doubled stock cap. If higher-confidence roof is absent keep scope local and report actual fixed pre- vs post-restoration image limitations instead of promising full building. No real photos shipped.
appearance.sourceDiscrepancies: PEI Register says 70ft in descriptive copy, but CCG tabular structure + environment ministry physical case + museum society agree 18.3m (60ft); their 26.8m is focal height above water. Separate sources disagree 1863/1864 dates, so do not call it exact unless independently resolved.
